main_measure.name: mean next-day excess return on forecast > 0 bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and slope t >= 1; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of next-day excess return on forecast

reading: Active bars counted as bars with forecast > 0 and a next-day close in the same window; the coin's mean daily return is over all its close-to-close returns in all windows; the plan's 'fewer than 200 is inconclusive' is reported as 'not observable' per the workflow.
decided_by: Mean next-day excess return above 0 with t >= 2 and a positive slope with t >= 1.

direction_check.why: no check fold (the plan has none, or the backtest did not run on its folds)
